title: Shifted Tate-line endomorphisms on a connected geometric scheme
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $N\ge1$ invertible in $k$, and $B$ a commutative $\mathbf Z/N$-algebra. Let $Y$ be a nonempty connected $k$-scheme [def-weil-connected-scheme]. On its small etale site let $B_Y(1)=\mu_{N,Y}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}B_Y$ and $L=B_Y(r)[d]$ for integers $r\ge0$ and $d$, with tensor-power Tate twist [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] and derived shift in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Then the scalar map
$$B\longrightarrow\operatorname{End}_{D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},B)}(L),\qquad b\longmapsto b\,1_L$$
is a bijection. In particular, for any $B$-linear functor [def-weil-linear-category] $G:D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},B)\to D((\operatorname{Spec}k)_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ and any isomorphism $G(L)\cong B_{\operatorname{Spec}k}$, an endomorphism $v:L\to L$ is an isomorphism whenever $G(v)$ is an isomorphism. Here $B$-linear means $G(bf)=bG(f)$ on every morphism group.
